item.title: The Hidden Cost of Renovation Waste Most Homeowners Never Budget For
item.description: Renovation budgets usually start with the obvious numbers: materials, labour, fixtures, finishes. Yet one cost almost always sits outside that planning process until it becomes unavoidable: renovation waste.
